ends.start: SW: at the Trincomali Channel end, stopping short of the inside junction fan — south-west of about 49.006 the water opens into the Trincomali / Houstoun Passage junction and the shoal fan off Valdes Island, where a cross-section measures a basin rather than a channel.
ends.end: NE: at the Strait of Georgia mouth off the outer end of the pass (~49.024). Beyond that the bottom falls away into the Strait and there is no channel left to measure.

notes.flood_direction: Flood sets NORTH-EAST through Porlier Pass — Trincomali Channel out into the Strait of Georgia (the Gulf Islands passes flood outward into the Strait, which is the opposite of the intuition that the flood comes in from the Strait). flood_deg 30 is the CHS IWLS station metadata floodDirection for the Porlier Pass current station (ebbDirection 210). Seed drawn SW->NE. Through the narrows itself the channel runs closer to due north, so the thalweg bearing at the anchor is ~25 deg off the fitted flood axis — inside sections.py's 60 deg assert.
notes.spring_max_kn: 9.76 kn — maximum |value| over every EXTREMA_FLOOD/EXTREMA_EBB event in the CHS IWLS wcp1-events series for the whole of 2026 (2821 events), at 2026-05-17T21:28Z on a flood (2026-05-16 new moon). Matches the ~9 kn Sailing Directions and the Canadian tide tables give for Porlier. Station resolved by officialName against the IWLS station list, not by a provider-minted id (station-corrections policy).
notes.cd_to_mwl_m: 2.59 m = Mean Water Level above chart datum at the Porlier Pass TIDE station (IWLS heights, MWL height type) — the same place, so no transfer.
notes.bathymetry: GSC Canada West Coast Topo-Bathymetric DEM, 10 m, version 2 (NRCan, OGL-Canada). Vertical datum CHS chart datum, elevation-up (water negative) -> tile_value "elevation"; both verified, see data/tiles/porlier-pass/MANIFEST.json.
notes.thalweg_seed: Least-cost route (cost 1/depth^2, land impassable) from a point in Trincomali Channel to one in the Strait of Georgia, decimated to ~100 m. Least depth along it is 24.5 m. sections.py's refinement owns the final centreline.
